excludedRows.reason: Same customer name and same SKU as row 59 of 101-zhenshipingjia.xlsx; exclude the second occurrence to avoid duplicate customer/SKU attribution.

reviews.productSourceTitle: 2000ml Gradient Large Capacity Water Bottle with Carry Handle
reviews.author: Maya Collins
reviews.reviewBody: The carry handle makes the 2L size manageable between the locker room and the training floor. We checked the first carton for lid fit and found only one cosmetic mark.

reviews.productSourceTitle: 800ml Clear Sports Water Bottle with Carry Loop
reviews.author: Felix Baumann
reviews.reviewBody: The clear body helps customers compare the fill level at a glance.

reviews.productSourceTitle: 1300ml Gradient Compact Water Jug with Carry Handle
reviews.author: Noura Saleh
reviews.reviewBody: This size works better on office desks than the larger jugs we tested. The handle feels secure when full.

reviews.productSourceTitle: 1300ml Illustrated Clear Compact Water Jug with Carry Handle
reviews.author: Luc Martin
reviews.reviewBody: The printed illustrations gave our gift set a finished look without adding another accessory. We checked the artwork position on the decorated sample and the production pieces stayed close to it.

reviews.productSourceTitle: 1000ml Gradient Sports Water Bottle with Time Markers
reviews.author: Brooke Turner
reviews.reviewBody: The time markers are easy for buyers to understand and made our challenge packs simpler to explain. The gradient shade varied slightly between two cartons, so we now approve a color reference before the run.

reviews.productSourceTitle: 1000ml Clear Sports Water Bottle with Time Markers
reviews.author: Sander de Jong
reviews.reviewBody: We chose the clear version for a cycling event because the contents are visible. The markers print was clean and the lid threads felt even across the pieces we checked. A second neutral lid color would make the range easier to merchandise.

reviews.productSourceTitle: 1000ml Flip-Top Sports Water Bottle with Time Markers
reviews.author: Camila Rocha
reviews.reviewBody: The flip top is practical when customers are moving between exercises. A few lids were tight on the first samples, but the final batch opened more smoothly.

reviews.productSourceTitle: 1300ml Gradient Compact Water Jug with Carry Strap
reviews.author: Noah Bennett
reviews.reviewBody: The strap is the feature customers ask about for beach and picnic use. It gives the jug a better carrying option than a plain bottle, and the gradient colors looked consistent on the shelf.

reviews.author: Youssef Amrani
reviews.reviewBody: The straw format is popular with commuters who want to drink without removing a cap. We included a cleaning brush in our own bundle and customers understood the care instructions. The flip lid stayed closed in our sample-bag test.

reviews.productSourceTitle: Gradient Sports Bottles with Time Markers
reviews.author: Petra Horáková
reviews.reviewBody: The time markers give this model a clear reason to choose it over a plain bottle. Gradient matching was good across the cartons, and the print was readable without looking too busy.

reviews.author: Harriet Cole
reviews.reviewBody: The compact jug fits neatly into the school bundle we prepared.

reviews.author: Kwesi Boateng
reviews.reviewBody: The handle is the main selling point for our gym customers. We received clear carton counts and the mixed colors were packed as agreed.

reviews.productSourceTitle: Gradient Sports Bottles with Carry Loops
reviews.author: Mila Stoyanova
reviews.reviewBody: The carry loop is useful for hanging the bottle on a small bag. Gradient colors looked attractive in product photos and close to the physical sample.

reviews.productSourceTitle: Clear Sports Bottles with Carry Rings
reviews.author: Kenji Watanabe
reviews.reviewBody: The clear finish is simple and easy to photograph for our catalog. We checked the necks and rings from several cartons and the parts were cleanly finished.

reviews.author: Giulia Bianchi
reviews.reviewBody: The smaller flip-top format works well for studio classes and short training sessions. The gradient makes the product stand out without extra packaging. We asked for a darker lid on the next color mix because it shows less handling dust.

reviews.author: Amina Yusuf
reviews.reviewBody: The carry ring is handy for customers who move between work and the gym. The next shipment used better separation and arrived cleaner.

reviews.author: Lena Vogt
reviews.reviewBody: The 550ml size is easy to place in smaller gym bags and school packs. We checked the neck finish, lid fit and base on a sample group and found them consistent.

reviews.author: Omar Al Mansouri
reviews.reviewBody: The 750ml size is a useful middle option for our gym bundle customers. The bottle feels light when empty and stable when filled. We needed an extra confirmation on the carton labels, but the final marks were correct.

reviews.author: Lauren Price
reviews.reviewBody: We used this shape for a staff wellness pack with a simple logo. The print area was easy to work with and the proof was a good guide for the delivered pieces.

reviews.author: Stefan Huber
reviews.reviewBody: We added this model in a mixed sample review for a regional sports retailer.

reviews.author: Darius Miller
reviews.reviewBody: The 1200ml volume is a strong fit for strength-training customers who do not want to refill halfway through a session. Sample approval and carton counts were both easy to follow.

reviews.author: Nur Aisyah
reviews.reviewBody: The 600ml size is comfortable for children to carry without making the school bag feel heavy. Parents liked the simple opening, but we reminded them to check the lid after closing.

reviews.author: Matteo Ricci
reviews.reviewBody: This bottle was selected for a school sports program because the size is easy to hand out. The bright colors helped us separate teams, and the surfaces arrived without noticeable scuffs.

reviews.author: Carmen Ruiz
reviews.reviewBody: We put this one for school and amateur club orders. The shape is familiar and the 550ml capacity is easy to explain. The first color sample looked warmer than expected, so we confirmed the reference before production and the final mix was closer.

reviews.author: Hassan Raza
reviews.reviewBody: The 750ml bottle gives our customers a little more than a standard small sports bottle without looking oversized. We appreciated getting the carton dimensions before booking freight.

reviews.author: Naoki Fujita
reviews.reviewBody: The 800ml size works well for team orders. We inspected the cap threads and the base on arrival, and the finish was consistent.

reviews.author: Clara Meier
reviews.reviewBody: The 1L format continues to sell well for our outdoor customers. The bottle sits securely when full and the closure fit was even in our spot check. The supplier kept the model and color details clear on the paperwork.

reviews.author: Chinedu Okoro
reviews.reviewBody: Customers like the 800ml size for everyday gym use. We allowed extra time for production on the reorder and the schedule was easier to manage.

reviews.author: María Fernanda Soto
reviews.reviewBody: We supplied this model to a youth football program with a small printed mark.

reviews.author: Youssef Hassan
reviews.reviewBody: The larger capacity is popular with our summer gym customers. We had to confirm the packing mix twice, but the delivered assortment was right.

reviews.author: Matías Rojas
reviews.reviewBody: The shape gives us a good printable area for brewery and event merchandise. We checked the logo position on a physical sample before approving the run.

reviews.author: Elin Andersson
reviews.reviewBody: The transparent body is useful for parents who want to see the remaining drink. The smaller size fits children's hands and lunch bags.

reviews.author: Ville Laaksonen
reviews.reviewBody: The clear 650ml format is a good commuter size and easy to display with travel accessories. We took a close look at the transparency and lid fit on a sample set and were happy with both. The carton labeling was straightforward.

reviews.author: Sophie McKenzie
reviews.reviewBody: The wide opening makes the 1600ml jug practical for camping refills and cleaning. Our mixed-color order matched the packing confirmation.

reviews.author: Lars Nielsen
reviews.reviewBody: The 1600ml capacity works for customers who want a larger bottle without moving to the very biggest jug. The handle is comfortable and the cap closed evenly on our checks.

reviews.author: Inês Carvalho
reviews.reviewBody: The 2200ml size is popular with gym customers who stay for a long session. It stands steadily on a flat surface and the handle is easy to find. Freight planning took one extra confirmation because the carton is larger than a normal bottle.

reviews.author: Martin Kovář
reviews.reviewBody: The large jug is easy to refill and the closure feels secure when carried from the car to the training room. We checked the measurement marks on the sample and they were readable.

reviews.author: Jordan Ellis
reviews.reviewBody: The 3800ml capacity is what our high-volume training customers were looking for.

reviews.author: Valeria Gómez
reviews.reviewBody: The big capacity and measurement lines make this easy to position for long workouts. Delivery moved by a few days, but updates were provided before we had to ask.

reviews.author: Bram van Dijk
reviews.reviewBody: The clean shape works well with a simple one-color logo. The printed proof helped us catch a small placement adjustment before production.

reviews.author: Faisal Khan
reviews.reviewBody: The 800ml size is a comfortable choice for gym bags and the surface looks more polished than several lower-priced options we compared. We saw a couple of tiny marks in the sample group, and replacements were included.

reviews.author: Thomas Evans
reviews.reviewBody: The 2L jug gave our event kits a clear practical use instead of being another small giveaway bottle. The handle was the deciding feature and felt secure when full. We would prefer a slightly tighter carton fit next time.

reviews.author: Wanjiku Njeri
reviews.reviewBody: The capacity suits office desks and shared training rooms. Cartons were neat and easy to move.

reviews.author: Katarzyna Zielińska
reviews.reviewBody: The 1500ml size has been a good compromise for customers who think 2L is too much. The cap closes firmly and the bottle is not awkward to carry.

reviews.author: Bálint Nagy
reviews.reviewBody: The 2300ml jug looks substantial without feeling unnecessarily heavy when empty. It has a useful presence on a gym shelf and the handle is easy to grip. We are considering a sleeve for the next retail presentation.

reviews.author: Sienna Walsh
reviews.reviewBody: This small 380ml bottle fits well in kids' sports packs and works for shorter activities. The colors are cheerful and the caps were seated properly in our sample check.

reviews.author: Radu Ionescu
reviews.reviewBody: The 650ml capacity is easy to position as an everyday bottle rather than a specialist sports item.

reviews.author: Mei Chen
reviews.reviewBody: This model has been a dependable mid-size option for our repeat customers. We had to remind the team about one packing preference, then it was handled.

reviews.author: Diego Valdés
reviews.reviewBody: The 1L bottle gives us a practical base model for sports and promotional orders. The surface took our logo cleanly and the bottle looked even across the pieces we checked.

reviews.author: Ciara Byrne
reviews.reviewBody: The 1200ml size is popular with members who want a longer session between refills. We checked the lids and bases from the shipment and found no functional issue.

reviews.author: Emre Yıldız
reviews.reviewBody: The 800ml model is easy to bundle with basic gym accessories. Logo placement was accurate and the bottle color was close to our reference card. Samples arrived quickly enough for our seasonal buying review.

reviews.author: Miriam Keller
reviews.reviewBody: The 750ml capacity suits older primary-school children who need more than a small bottle. We would like a more muted option for school uniforms.

reviews.author: Ewa Nowak
reviews.reviewBody: The 650ml size has been easy to sell for school and after-school activities. Parents like the balance between capacity and weight, and the colors are visible without extra labels.

reviews.author: Rachel Green
reviews.reviewBody: Individual bags kept the bottles clean during our receiving process. The 750ml size is popular with older children, although it needs a little more room in smaller backpacks. The lid finish was consistent across the order.

reviews.author: Paula Herrera
reviews.reviewBody: The proportions feel comfortable for children and the bottle is simple to explain to parents. We specifically checked the lid opening and found the production pieces smoother than the first sample.

reviews.author: Yuki Tanaka
reviews.reviewBody: The 600ml format fits kindergarten bags without taking up the whole side pocket.

reviews.author: Maryam Al Hashimi
reviews.reviewBody: This 750ml bottle was a good match for the school-supplies season. Shipment timing worked with our buying calendar.

reviews.author: Beatriz Santos
reviews.reviewBody: The 600ml bottle sits nicely beside notebooks and lunch accessories in our shop. The shape looks friendly without being flimsy, and the caps were checked before display.

reviews.author: James Walker
reviews.reviewBody: The 650ml size is useful for older children and the bottle itself arrived in good condition. Two outer cartons had dents, but the inner packing protected the contents.

reviews.author: Ana Ribeiro
reviews.reviewBody: The 800ml model gives us a practical price point for local gyms. Customers comment that it feels comfortable in the hand, and the lid fit was consistent in our sample check. Reordering was easier because the model code stayed clear.

reviews.author: Krešimir Babić
reviews.reviewBody: The 1200ml kids format is large, but it works for school teams that spend a full day outdoors. The bottle needs a larger school bag than the smaller models.

reviews.author: Tara Wilson
reviews.reviewBody: The matte finish is useful for gym customers because it hides small handling marks. The 800ml capacity feels balanced in a side pocket and the body did not wobble when full.

reviews.author: Helena Bauer
reviews.reviewBody: The clean lines make this 1L bottle look more expensive on the shelf than the price suggests. We took a close look at weight and thread fit on a sample group and found them even. A more detailed color card would help our next selection.

reviews.author: Salim Al Harthy
reviews.reviewBody: The 1600ml jug is a useful option for hot-weather outdoor orders where customers prefer fewer refills. The handle feels stable and the mixed colors arrived in the agreed ratio.

reviews.author: Caleb Johnson
reviews.reviewBody: The 2400ml size is a strong match for bodybuilding customers who spend several hours at the gym.

reviews.productSourceTitle: 1600ml Large Capacity Plastic Water Jug (Transparent Variant)
reviews.author: Mantas Petrauskas
reviews.reviewBody: The transparent variant gives a clean look and lets users see the remaining volume. The clear finish had no obvious haze.

reviews.author: Aoife Ryan
reviews.reviewBody: The 1600ml jug works well for family camping kits. The wide opening makes rinsing easier and the cap closed securely in our carry test.

reviews.author: Kwame Mensah
reviews.reviewBody: The 2400ml capacity gives customers good value for a long training day. The jug was well protected in the master carton and the body finish was clean.

reviews.productSourceTitle: 1600ml Large Capacity Plastic Water Jug (Transparent Variant)
reviews.author: Jana Novotná
reviews.reviewBody: The clear 1600ml jug has a neat display appearance and makes the volume easy to judge. The handle is comfortable, and the lids from the inspected cartons fit properly. A printed scale would make this version even more practical.

reviews.productSourceTitle: 2400ml Large Capacity Plastic Water Jug (Transparent Variant)
reviews.author: Laura Mendoza
reviews.reviewBody: The transparent 2400ml jug is popular with customers who want to see their intake during training. The larger size needs a little more room in the retail fixture.

reviews.author: João Ferreira
reviews.reviewBody: The 1100ml size is a comfortable step up from a regular bottle and easier to carry than a very large jug. The handle sits well in the hand and the cap closed cleanly.

reviews.author: Claire Bernard
reviews.reviewBody: The 1600ml capacity is practical for day trips and the wide body feels stable on a picnic table. The first lid sample was firm, but the final pieces were easier to open. Packing was tidy and there were no transit marks.

reviews.author: Soo-jin Kim
reviews.reviewBody: The 550ml size fits lunch bags and is not too heavy for younger pupils. The finish felt smooth and the bright colors helped us create simple school bundles.

reviews.author: Amelia Price
reviews.reviewBody: The 650ml version is popular for back-to-school because it gives children enough for a morning without being bulky.

reviews.author: Sadia Rahman
reviews.reviewBody: The 550ml bottle is a sensible starter size and fits small hands. The color selection was a little brighter than our original idea, so we will use a reference card next time.

reviews.author: Valeria Torres
reviews.reviewBody: The light weight is the main reason parents chose this 650ml model. It worked well in a school promotion and the bottle surfaces arrived clean.

reviews.author: Rafael Oliveira
reviews.reviewBody: The 650ml shape is comfortable for children and looks good in a sports-club display. We asked for a small color mix and the supplier explained the available options clearly.

reviews.author: Elsa Lindström
reviews.reviewBody: The compact 550ml size suits preschoolers and leaves space in the bag for other items. We took a close look at the cap fit and a simple drop test on the sample set with no issue. The smooth finish was easy to wipe clean.

reviews.author: Nikos Georgiou
reviews.reviewBody: The 900ml jug fills the gap between a normal bottle and the larger models. We had one delayed carton update but the delivery arrived complete.

reviews.author: Milena Jovanović
reviews.reviewBody: The 1100ml volume is popular with gym customers who want a little more than a litre. The jug balances well when full and the handle is comfortable.

reviews.author: David Ben-Ami
reviews.reviewBody: The 1200ml format works for long outdoor days and does not feel too wide in a backpack side pocket. The cap stayed secure in our sample carry test. A clearer color guide would make repeat ordering quicker.

reviews.author: Lucía Romero
reviews.reviewBody: The 1600ml jug has a tidy finish and the lid fit was good across the pieces we opened. Customers like the larger size for training, though it needs a little shelf space.

reviews.author: Wei Ming Lim
reviews.reviewBody: The 800ml bottle is dependable for school and gym promotions.

reviews.author: Håkon Berg
reviews.reviewBody: The 1L bottle is a clean, flexible option for our outdoor line. The lid fit was consistent on the first pieces we checked.

reviews.author: Aiko Nakamura
reviews.reviewBody: The 600ml kids bottle has a simple look that works for both school and sport. The lid threads were smooth and the packing was neat.

reviews.author: Evan Brooks
reviews.reviewBody: We used the 800ml bottle for a campus giveaway with a one-color mark. The print placement was easy to confirm and the delivered pieces looked consistent.

reviews.author: Neha Kapoor
reviews.reviewBody: The 1L shape gives us a good value option for general sports orders. We inspected a few thousand-piece cartons and the cosmetic reject count was low. A more detailed carton photo before dispatch would help our receiving team.

reviews.author: Antoine Morel
reviews.reviewBody: The 1800ml jug feels sturdy without being as oversized as the 2L-plus range. We checked the handle before putting it on display.

reviews.author: Jordan Lee
reviews.reviewBody: The shaker ball handled a normal protein mix with only a little residue at the bottom. The lid was secure in our bag test and the 501 format is easy to merchandise with supplements.

reviews.author: Mariana López
reviews.reviewBody: The 700ml size is a good match for post-workout drinks and the measurement print was easy to read. We took a close look at the lid after several open-and-close cycles and it stayed aligned. Delivery took longer than our first estimate but the cartons were complete.

reviews.author: Adnan Kovač
reviews.reviewBody: The compact shaker fits gym bags well and mixes ordinary powder smoothly. The cap threads were easy to use, and the body did not feel flimsy.

reviews.author: Emily Carter
reviews.reviewBody: The smaller format is popular with our studio customers because it does not take up much locker space.

reviews.author: Arjun Patel
reviews.reviewBody: This shaker is a practical choice for supplement bundles where price and easy cleaning matter. The bottle itself was consistent.

reviews.author: Megan Reed
reviews.reviewBody: The related size options make it easier for us to build a small shaker family under one brand. The mixing performance was good in our test and the logo stayed readable after washing.

reviews.author: Sergio Navarro
reviews.reviewBody: Customers like being able to choose the size without changing the overall look of the shaker range. The lid closed securely and the body was easy to rinse.

reviews.author: Nina Keller
reviews.reviewBody: The 500ml size is easy to hand out at events and leaves a clean area for a logo. The print proof was close to the finished pieces, and the bottles arrived protected. It is a simple model that does its job well.

reviews.author: Oliver Hughes
reviews.reviewBody: The 550ml bottle works nicely in compact gift sets. The cartons arrived clean and the lids were seated properly.

reviews.author: Martín Pereira
reviews.reviewBody: The 650ml capacity is a comfortable everyday choice for our market. The bottle feels balanced when full and the finish looked consistent across the order.

reviews.author: Aisha Al Thani
reviews.reviewBody: The grip feels comfortable and the 550ml size suits gift and lifestyle bundles. The shipment was slower than hoped, but the cartons were complete and matched the confirmed colors. We will allow more lead time next season.

reviews.author: Minh Tran
reviews.reviewBody: The 1L capacity gives us good value for general sports and corporate orders. We compared two carton configurations and chose the one with lower freight space.

reviews.author: Kari Olsen
reviews.reviewBody: The 600ml bottle is a neat commuter and gym option, especially for smaller bags.
